A statement of account with open items, aged buckets (oldest bucket in the accent, per the system's accent policy), and an activity summary that must close to the same total the buckets sum to. Change the open items and re-derive the buckets and activity figures together — all three views reconcile to 35,731.24 in the sample (data.json carries the chain). The bucket figures are Georgia at 19px-equivalent with the total carrying a 2px accent rule.

**Engine features exercised:** @page margin boxes with page counters, aged-bucket typography, accent-ruled table totals under border-collapse edge ownership, split columns via explicit widths.

Render it:

```bash
npx @formepdf/html templates/statement/index.html -o statement.pdf
```

```css style.css
/* statement — page geometry and document-specific rules.
 * Spine comes from ../northmoor-shared.css. */

@page {
  size: Letter;
  margin: 52.5pt 57pt 40.5pt; /* 70px 76px 54px */
  @bottom-left {
    content: "Statement · Account BW-0091 · 07 September 2026";
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
  @bottom-right {
    content: "Page " counter(page) " of " counter(pages);
    font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    font-size: 5.625pt;
    letter-spacing: 0.14em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #8A857E;
  }
}

/* First-page 4px full-bleed accent head rule (escapes into the margin). */
.sheet { position: relative; }
.atop {
  position: absolute;
  top: -52.5pt;
  left: -57pt;
  right: -57pt;
  height: 3pt;
  background-color: #7B2233;
}
.meta-doc { grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; }
.sect { margin: 22.5pt 0 7.5pt; } /* 30px / 10px */
.twocol { display: flex; gap: 27pt; margin-top: 22.5pt; }
td.aged-dim { color: #8A857E; }
td.aged-accent { color: #7B2233; }
td.aged-total { border-top: 1.5pt solid #7B2233; }
.action { font-family: Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; font-size: 7.5pt; line-height: 1.65; }

/* Equal/ratio split columns: explicit widths (flex basis is not in
 * the subset; grow alone leaves intrinsic-width columns). */
.twocol > div { width: 47%; }
```
